purpose: Defines the default structure, ID scheme and naming of glossary files, including the glossary line at the top of requirement and design documents.
summary: Glossary doc_type, ID numbering via the next-spec-id skill, and file naming convention
Requirement-side glossaries use the requirement ID scheme, falling back to the GLS prefix
Design-side glossaries use the design ID scheme (default DES)
Glossary line placed right after the title of documents that use a glossary
Design documents list their own glossary IDs followed by those from the input requirements
Body table format with four columns: term, definition, prerequisite terms, disallowed paraphrases
Rules for what to write in each column and the none placeholder
tasks: Writing a requirements document that uses a glossary
Writing a design document that uses a glossary
